prompts.seed_text: Explain how unified memory affects local language model inference on Apple silicon. Include one practical measurement note.

Compare prefill and decode performance for a local language model. Discuss prompt length, memory bandwidth, quantization, thermal state, and why repeated measured runs matter. Use precise technical language and state which metrics make two machines comparable.

Write a technical analysis of single-node language model inference. Cover tokenizer cost, prompt prefill, autoregressive decode, unified memory, model quantization, cache growth, operating-system pressure, reproducible prompts, warmup behavior, version pinning, and network isolation. Distinguish measured facts from interpretation and explain how a later heterogeneous fleet can reuse the same harness without changing the benchmark contract.
